# Past Enlighten

> Past Enlighten is a Lahore-based tour company run by local guide Bilawal and a team of guides born and raised in the Walled City. It offers private and small-group guided tours of Lahore (Lahore Fort, Walled City, Badshahi Mosque, Wagah Border ceremony) and tailor-made trips across northern Pakistan (Hunza, Skardu, Swat, Neelum, Fairy Meadows). Tours can be booked online or on WhatsApp.

- Website: https://pastenlighten.com/
- Address: Fort Road, Walled City, Lahore, Pakistan
- Phone / WhatsApp: +92 334 4770455
- Email: infopastenlighten@gmail.com
- Languages: English, Urdu, Punjabi
